title: Agreement of term assignments
statement: Let $T$ be a conjunction of literals on $n$ variables, with distinct variable indices, and let its width be at most $w$. For any width-$w$ switching block code $B$, the assignment obtained by placing the code bits at the term’s literal positions and adjusting each by the bit representing that literal’s required sign, with zero assigned outside the term’s support, is the same assignment as the one defined directly from $T$ and $B$.
hypotheses_covered: $B$ is a switching block code of width $w$
$T$ is a term on $n$ variables with distinct literal indices
The width of $T$ is at most $w$
